listings.description: Welcome to The Art of Adornment: Icons of Luxury, an extraordinary 300-lot auction presented by Fortrove - Fine Jewelry, celebrating jewelry as both personal expression and wearable art. This carefully curated collection brings together creations from the worlds most celebrated jewelry houses, including Cartier, Tiffany & Co., Van Cleef & Arpels, Bvlgari, Hermes, Buccellati, Chanel, Christian Dior, Chopard, Piaget, Verdura, Mikimoto, and more. From sculptural gold and brilliant diamonds to vibrant gemstones, pearls, enamel, and iconic house motifs, each piece was selected to showcase the artistry, craftsmanship, and unmistakable design language that define the great maisons. Discover legendary signatures, important vintage designs, bold statement jewels, elegant everyday icons, and rare collector-worthy creations. The collection moves between timeless sophistication and artistic imagination, offering bidders an exceptional variety of rings, necklaces, bracelets, earrings, brooches, and distinctive signed treasures. With 300 lots spanning approachable luxury through important statement pieces, this auction has been assembled to create excitement at every level. Whether you are searching for a recognizable Cartier or Tiffany icon, a Van Cleef & Arpels collectible, a dramatic Bvlgari design, or something unexpected from one of the great jewelry houses, there is something extraordinary waiting to be discovered. For over 25 years, Fortrove - Fine Jewelry has specialized in sourcing exceptional designer and estate jewelry from around the world. Every designer item offered by Fortrove is 100% GUARANTEED AUTHENTIC. We invite collectors, jewelry enthusiasts, and new bidders alike to explore all 300 lots and experience the art of collecting luxury. Bid boldly. Collect beautifully. Discover something extraordinary.

listings.title: The Ultimate Closet Sale: 1,000+ Deadstock, Vintage & Designer Finds
listings.description: THE ULTIMATE CLOSET SALE — 1,000+ VINTAGE, DESIGNER & DEADSTOCK FINDS! This is not your average closet sale! For more than 30 years, Eleanor owned and operated a successful New Jersey boutique, Just For You, building a loyal clientele and curating an incredible collection of fashion along the way. When the boutique eventually closed, much of the remaining inventory came home with Eleanor — where it has remained carefully stored and waiting to be rediscovered ever since. Now, we are opening this incredible collection to the public with 1,000+ pieces of vintage, designer, formal and boutique fashion spanning decades of style. Expect clothing, formalwear, suits, jackets, shoes, handbags, accessories and more, with many pieces dating from the 1980s through the early 2000s. One of the most exciting aspects of this collection is the amount of deadstock and unworn merchandise still bearing its original tags. For vintage lovers, collectors, resellers, boutique owners and fashion enthusiasts, this is a unique opportunity to shop an extensive collection of styles that have been tucked away for decades. Whether you're searching for a one-of-a-kind vintage piece, building your resale collection, looking for unique formalwear, or simply love the thrill of discovering something you won't find in a typical store — this sale is worth the trip. PLEASE NOTE: A private shopping appointment is scheduled for the day before the public sale. Because this is a large collection and the private shopper may purchase anywhere from a handful of pieces to a significant portion of the inventory, the items shown in the photos are not guaranteed to still be available during the public sale. We will make every effort to update the listing photos with remaining inventory following the private sale so they provide the most accurate representation possible of what will be available. Come ready to browse, dig, and discover — after decades of waiting, this collection is finally ready for its next chapter! PLEASE NOTE: This sale is dedicated specifically to the clothing, shoes and accessories. The estate sale for the remainder of the home will take place the following weekend.
